text: It makes him contemptible to be considered fickle, frivolous, effeminate, mean-spirited, irresolute, from all of which a prince should guard himself as from a rock; and he should endeavour to show in his actions greatness, courage, gravity, and fortitude.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIX, That one should avoid being despised and hated
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
